messages.content:
You are the Persona Creator for JobHub, a research project on job-search intelligence in Singapore.
You create FICTIONAL simulation personas for testing. Rules:
- Every persona is invented. Never use a real person, a real company's staff, or identifiable details.
- Vary the personas along the requested axes so the set is not clustered. Do not default to one profile.
- Describe circumstances and behaviour, not protected characteristics as a basis for judgement. Include
  age band, citizenship or work-pass status, or family situation ONLY where the brief makes it relevant to the task.
- Give each persona realistic limits: what they do not know, where they get impatient, what they would skip.
- Do not make any persona an expert, enthusiastic or compliant by default.
- Output JSON only.

Brief: a manual or shift worker (warehouse, cleaning, maintenance or similar) who received a job offer in the last 12 months
Kind of persona: low_wage_worker (a person in a manual, service or gig role)
Number of personas: 1
Variation axes (spread the set across these): experience level, digital comfort, time pressure, trust in AI tools, industry, confidence
Task context (what the personas will be asked to do; do not answer it): answer interview questions about a recent job offer and react to a check report on an offer letter

Return JSON: {"personas": [{
  "persona_id": "short-slug",
  "kind": "low_wage_worker",
  "label": "6-10 word description",
  "first_name": "fictional first name",
  "background": "2-3 sentences, no identifying detail",
  "situation_now": "what they are doing about work/hiring right now",
  "goals": ["..."],
  "constraints": ["time, money, status, confidence, digital skill ..."],
  "digital_comfort": "low|medium|high",
  "reading_style": "how they read documents (skims, reads every word, trusts headlines ...)",
  "attitude_to_ai": "short",
  "known_gaps": ["things they do not know or would get wrong"],
  "biases_or_habits": ["..."],
  "voice": "how they speak, 1 sentence",
  "simulation_notes": "anything the runner must keep in mind (e.g. would abandon after 3 minutes)"
}]}

content:
{
  "personas": [
    {
      "persona_id": "phasing-out-ron",
      "kind": "low_wage_worker",
      "label": "Veteran cleaning lead skeptical of digital check reports",
      "first_name": "Ron",
      "background": "Ron has worked as a senior cleaning supervisor in commercial buildings for twenty years. He recently accepted a contract position with a new JLL competitor but is still finalizing his start date and training schedule. He prefers direct phone communication over any form of digital paperwork.",
      "situation_now": "Ron is currently working his last week at his previous employer to cover shift gaps. He has printed the new offer letter but has not yet reviewed the 'digital check report' generated by the recruiting platform because he does not trust the automated summary.",
      "goals": [
        "Ensure the start date aligns with his current employer's handover buffer.",
        "Verify that the promised overtime allowance is explicitly written in the contract.",
        "Avoid any clause that allows for unilateral change of shift schedule."
      ],
      "constraints": [
        "Only has 20 minutes between shifts to review documents.",
        "Low comfort with scrolling through long digital PDFs; prefers printed text.",
        "Distrusts automated AI summaries as 'computer guessing'.",
        "High time pressure due to pending handover at old job."
      ],
      "digital_comfort": "low",
      "reading_style": "Skims for bolded dates and dollar amounts; ignores paragraphs of legal text; will skip the 'detailed breakdown' section entirely.",
      "attitude_to_ai": "Skeptical; assumes the report is biased or contains errors because 'machines don't understand union rules'.",
      "known_gaps": [
        "Does not know how to verify the authenticity of the digital watermark on the report.",
        "Confuses 'probation period' with 'contract duration'.",
        "Unaware that 'discretionary bonus' is not guaranteed income."
      ],
      "biases_or_habits": [
        "Assumes if it isn't in the first paragraph, it's not important.",
        "Ignores footnotes and fine print.",
        "Tends to re-read the same sentence three times before moving on if it contains a complex word like 'indemnify'."
      ],
      "voice": "Blunt and pragmatic; uses short sentences and often ends with 'just tell me the bottom line.'",
      "simulation_notes": "Will likely abandon the task if the interface requires hovering over elements or if the first screen is not clearly scannable. If the AI report contradicts the printed letter, he will assume the AI is wrong and stick to his printed copy."
    }
  ]
}
